unit: Single routine editor-task change, two linked issue histories

records.purpose: Find and communicate the current editor location
records.observation: A feature request describes indirect ways to obtain line and column. A commenter describes needing the position when switching to an external coding assistant.
records.limit: Reported use, not an observed end-to-end task or a measure of agent impact.

records.observation: Merged changes introduce the position announcement and add it to help. The action binds Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+G and reads the raw column.
records.limit: A code change and an issue closure do not establish accurate speech, reliable access or use.

records.observation: A collaborator reports an incorrect visible column around tabs through the command palette and a Windows shortcut failure. A second collaborator reports not reproducing the shortcut failure on Windows. The timeline records reopening.
records.limit: Two different checks and differing reports; the exact environment and cause of the divergent shortcut behavior are not established.

records.purpose: Correct visible column, separately from invocation
records.observation: The January 7 patch corrects visible-column calculation without changing the keybinding. On January 8 a collaborator confirms the column correction and still reports failure of the old shortcut on two Windows machines. The issue was labeled verified.
records.limit: The positive check concerns the column, with shortcut failure separately reported. It does not cover other configurations or all purposes.

records.purpose: Invoke the command from the focused editor
records.observation: The merged patch adds Alt on Windows and a text-focus condition. The PR author reports testing Windows/NVDA and macOS/VoiceOver.
records.limit: Team test report, not an independent accessibility review; no evidence every configuration worked.

records.purpose: Keep existing access to source control
records.observation: A linked issue attributes the shortcut conflict to the original change. One commenter suggests deleting the new binding. The subsequent default uses a separate key combination and requires accessibility mode and editor text focus.
records.limit: The workaround shows reported adjustment work, not time cost, frequency or the affected population. No private priority-setting or exclusive decision rights are observable.

records.purpose: Keep both actions available by distinct routes
records.observation: The change was backported. At the 1.108.1 source tag the position command and the platform-specific source-control route have distinct keybindings. The 1.109.0 command source and February release note also show the new position shortcut.
records.limit: Tags and release notes document distribution-related artifacts, not what any installation or end user experienced.

records.purpose: Source-control shortcut in the regression thread
records.observation: A commenter reports a satisfactory check on 1.108.1 in the source-control regression thread.
records.limit: No environment or procedure supplied. Code coexistence and this report do not establish successful cursor announcements for this user, or stable gains across users.

proposed_record: Record each purpose separately with affected task, invocation route, build, environment, evidence type, observed result, and remaining burden or unknown. Permit positive and negative observations under the same issue status.
narrow_inference: An issue marked verified cannot be treated as evidence that all paths or affected purposes worked: V4 records success for visible column and residual failure for keyboard invocation; V6–V8 track a distinct source-control task. This is a bounded logical counterexample to the broad reading of a label, not an estimated causal effect.
unknowns: Runtime behavior for all OS, keymaps and screen readers
